review_scope: static: retail instructions and emitted candidate listing

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: 6 retail bytes, 2 instructions, 1 block, 0 edges; candidate 1/0 at CFG 1.000.

checks.name: cfg_match
checks.rationale: Both decoders and the candidate report 1/0; straight-line body, no branch.

checks.name: behavior
checks.rationale: Loads the setting field at 0x00539548 into al and returns; only al is written so the value is byte-sized.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: One entry and one exit: the single ret at offset +5. There is no branch, no early return and no error path to compare.

checks.name: extent
checks.rationale: The region extent comes from measured references, not from an instruction: the ten consecutive byte stores at 0x0041556A-0x004155D6 for 0x00539540, and the dword loads at 0x00407C4A/0x00407C8F for 0x005690D8.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: No ABI arguments: the routine takes void and reads only the static field at 0x00539548.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: One constant in the body: the displacement of 0x00539548. No scale factor, mask or rounding is applied.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Exactly one load from 0x00539548; no store, no bounds check, no indirect access.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: No call and no store: the only effect is the returned byte, so there is no side effect to compare.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The body performs no floating-point load, store or arithmetic; it moves one integer byte.
